text:
Alex S.: Heads up — SageWave POC kickoff is tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need a quick sync on agenda, success criteria, prompts/evals, and any enterprise/security blockers. Who's joining from their side?

Maya L.: I have the intake sheet. Attendees: Product lead (Ravi), ML eng (Jin), Infra (Sara). They want RAG for support articles + a short Q&A bot.

Ben P.: Two quick infra notes: 1) target latency 150ms p95 for 256-token responses; 2) they want Dedicated infra for the POC (reserved pool). Need to confirm GPU type.

Taylor C.: On success criteria: propose these three — relevance >= 0.7 (embedding cosine), hallucination rate < 5% on eval set, and average response time < 200ms. Also acceptance: 80% of runbook queries answered correctly in blind eval.

Alex S.: Nice. Can we put the agenda in the meeting invite? Draft below — please edit: ```
10:00 — Introductions & roles (5m)
10:05 — Goals & success criteria (10m)
10:15 — Technical discovery: infra, data access, prompts (20m)
10:35 — Eval plan & timelines (10m)
10:45 — Security / compliance Qs (10m)
10:55 — Next steps & owners (5m)
```

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll update the invite. Who's owning the eval harness and prompt set?

Maya L.: I'll own prompt/eval creation. Ben — can you confirm we can provision a g4dn-equivalent for Dedicated or do we need p4? Also need an estimate of cost for their 2-week POC.

Ben P.: For the target latency, g5 (A10G equivalent) is recommended. I'll put together a rough pricing note: baseline estimate $6k/week for reserved capacity + token cost. Will validate tomorrow.

Alex S.: Security side — they shared an SCCM questionnaire. Any red flags?

security-bot: [scan] SCCM questionnaire received: 28 questions. Top flagged areas: KMS integration, audit logging retention, SSO/SCIM.

Taylor C.: We'll need to confirm: can they use their KMS (yes via Private deployment) or do they want Redwood-managed keys? Also need retention window for logs (they asked 7 years — likely enterprise add-on).

Maya L.: For the evals — I propose: 100 example prompts from their support logs (redacted), holdout 20 for blind scoring. Metrics: embedding cosine, exact-match on KB retrieval, and human QA on hallucination.

Alex S.: Good. Discovery questions for tomorrow: 
- Data access: will they allow us to ingest a sample of KB? S3 path?
- Auth: SSO type (Okta/Azure)? SCIM support?
- KMS: bring-your-own? HSM required?
- Scale: expected QPS during POC and typical payload sizes
- Success decision: who signs off (product + ML + infra)?

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll add sign-off owners to the invite and attach the intake sheet + SCCM.

Ben P.: One more infra ask: do they need on-prem network peering or is VPC-only enough? If peering, lead time ~2 weeks for network approvals.

Maya L.: They said "air-gapped for production" but ok with VPC for POC. Note that if they want HSM we should flag procurement timelines.

Alex S.: Action items before kickoff: 
- Ben: pricing + GPU rec + confirm provisioning time (owner: Ben)
- Maya: draft prompt set + eval plan (owner: Maya)
- Priya: update invite + attach docs (owner: Priya)
- Taylor: prepare SLA/retention options & note compliance add-ons (owner: Taylor)
- Ben/Taylor: confirm network/KMS feasibility (joint)

Taylor C.: I'll draft the SLA blurb and retention options now. Will post in this thread when done. :thumbsup:

Ben P.: Pricing note posted in sales drive. Quick summary: ~"$12k for 2-week Dedicated POC + variable token fees, option to convert to monthly reserved at discount". Will share exact numbers tomorrow.

Alex S.: Great — if we can get the SCCM responses flagged before the call that would be ideal. Maya, can you prioritize a small blind eval so we can present a number at the end of week 1?

Maya L.: Yep — I'll push a 20-sample blind eval by EOD tomorrow.

security-bot: Reminder: security review SLA is 3 business days after questionnaire clarification.

Alex S.: Perfect. See you all in the invite. If anything blocks, ping me directly.

Taylor C.: Quick question — pricing ask from customer: do we offer hourly burst pricing instead of weekly reserved for short POCs?

Ben P.: We can do hourly burst but capacity not guaranteed; will likely add a 20% premium. Mention in the call as an option.

Alex S.: OK closing thread. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
